title: A real-life digital intervention for personalized nutrition in adults with overweight or obesity: remote randomized controlled trial
core_idea: Assess the feasibility of a fully remote, fully digital randomized controlled nutritional intervention for adults with overweight or obesity, focusing on participant experience and the ability to perform do-it-yourself anthropometric measurements at home; secondarily evaluate whether self-collected data can detect anthropometric changes and compare generic versus personalized nutrition advice, with and without personalized food boxes.
tldr: A fully online 3-arm randomized trial protocol testing whether personalized (and personalized-plus-food-box) versus generic nutrition advice can be delivered remotely, whether participants can self-collect anthropometric and dietary data at home, and whether this approach is feasible for evaluating changes in body measurements and user experience.
